name: Alpha Signal Research
description: Research cross-sectional signals and measure what survives after costs.

lessonObjectives.l1-choosing-a-universe: Define a stock universe as it was known on each date.
lessonObjectives.l2-splits-and-dividends: Adjust prices for splits and dividends.
lessonObjectives.l3-including-the-dead: Keep delisted shares in the universe to avoid survivorship bias.
lessonObjectives.l4-returns-panel: Build a date-by-stock panel of returns.
lessonObjectives.l7-ranks-and-z: Normalise a signal across stocks on each date.
lessonObjectives.l8-neutralising: Neutralise a signal to the market and to sectors.
lessonObjectives.l9-information-coefficient: Compute the rank IC on each date and summarise it.
lessonObjectives.l10-decay: Measure the IC at several horizons.
lessonObjectives.l11-quintiles: Sort stocks into quintiles and compare their returns.
lessonObjectives.l12-combining: Combine momentum and reversal and check how they correlate.
lessonObjectives.l13-long-short: Build a dollar-neutral long-short portfolio from a signal.
lessonObjectives.l14-turnover-and-costs: Measure turnover and subtract realistic costs.
lessonObjectives.l15-sharpe-after-costs: Report the Sharpe ratio after costs with a confidence interval.
lessonObjectives.l16-research-note: Write a research note with IC, turnover and Sharpe after costs.
